# Strata — Design & Agent Engineering Index

Curated design resources, UI libraries, AI prompt packs, security tools and agent skills for fast human browsing and native AI agent discovery.

## Discovery tracks

- **design-ui** — Design & UI: 132 resources across 8 categories.
- **ai-agents** — IA & Agentes: 152 resources across 5 categories.
- **dev-tools** — Dev Tools & Segurança: 69 resources across 2 categories.

## Free MCP servers

**43 free/open-source MCP servers** are declared with the `free-mcp` tag. Query with `search_resources: free-mcp limit: 60`. Subdomain aliases: `mcp database`, `mcp design`, `mcp cloud`, `mcp coding`, `mcp browser`, `mcp automation`, `mcp proxy`.

## Agent Templates

**33 deployable agent templates** are in the `agent-templates` category. Retrieve all with `filter_by_category: agent-templates` or `search_resources: agent-template limit: 60`. Archetypes: `template-starter` (12), `template-research` (8), `template-multi-agent` (10), `template-coding` (5), `template-browser` (2), `template-voice` (3), `template-ui` (9), `template-local` (7).

## Metadata governance

- Declared pricing: 267 resources.
- Unknown pricing: 86 resources — reported as `unknown`, never inferred from category.
- Declared `whenToUse`: 268.
- Declared `stack`: 231.
- Declared `resourceType`: 268.
- Declared `repoUrl`: 192 (includes values derived from explicit GitHub URLs; provenance is exposed in `catalog.json`).
- Declared `agentConsumable`: 267.

### Endpoint selection guide
1. **/?q=...** — human UI with shareable search state.
2. **/llms.txt** — concise machine-readable index.
3. **/llms-full.txt** — complete Markdown dump of all 353 resources.
4. **/catalog.json** — complete JSON via GET with provenance.
5. **/api/a2a** — JSON-RPC 2.0 POST for filtered queries.

## A2A Examples

### List categories
POST /api/a2a
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"message/send","params":{"message":{"role":"user","parts":[{"kind":"text","text":"list_categories"}]}},"id":1}

### Filter by category
POST /api/a2a
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"message/send","params":{"message":{"role":"user","parts":[{"kind":"text","text":"filter_by_category: components"}]}},"id":2}

### Filter all agent templates
POST /api/a2a
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"message/send","params":{"message":{"role":"user","parts":[{"kind":"text","text":"filter_by_category: agent-templates"}]}},"id":6}

### Search resources
POST /api/a2a
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"message/send","params":{"message":{"role":"user","parts":[{"kind":"text","text":"search_resources: tailwind"}]}},"id":3}

### Search all free MCP servers
POST /api/a2a
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"message/send","params":{"message":{"role":"user","parts":[{"kind":"text","text":"search_resources: free-mcp limit: 60"}]}},"id":5}

### Get resource details
POST /api/a2a
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"message/send","params":{"message":{"role":"user","parts":[{"kind":"text","text":"get_resource_details: mcp-reference-servers"}]}},"id":4}

## Operating mode

Read-only / structured query. No external actions executed.
